'''Bo'az Klartag''' ({{langx|he|בועז קלרטג}}; born 25 April 1978) is an Israeli mathematician. He currently is a professor at the Weizmann Institute, and prior to that he was a professor at the Department of Pure Mathematics of [[Tel Aviv University]], where he earned his doctorate under the supervision of [[Vitali Milman]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=103104 }}</ref> Klartag made contributions in [[asymptotic geometric analysis]] and won the 2008 [[EMS Prize]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.6ecm.pl/en/history/past-ecm/5-ecm|title=5 ECM|publisher=ECM}}</ref> as well as the 2010 [[Erdős Prize]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://imu.org.il/Prizes/ErdosPrize/erdos_prize.html|title=Erdős Prize|publisher=[[Israel Mathematical Union]]|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130817024908/http://imu.org.il/Prizes/ErdosPrize/erdos_prize.html|archivedate=17 August 2013}}</ref> He is an editor of the [[Journal d'Analyse Mathématique]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://math.huji.ac.il/~w-jam/board.html|title=Editorial board|website=Journal d'Analyse Mathématique, homepage at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem|access-date=16 October 2022}}</ref>

*{{cite journal |last=Klartag |first=Bo'az |year=2007 |author-mask=3 |title=A central limit theorem for convex sets |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |volume=168 |issue=1 |pages=91–131 |doi=10.1007/s00222-006-0028-8 |arxiv=math/0605014 |bibcode=2007InMat.168...91K |s2cid=119169773 }}
*{{cite journal |last=Klartag |first=Bo'az |year=2006 |author-mask=3 |title=On convex perturbations with a bounded isotropic constant |journal=[[Geometric and Functional Analysis (journal)|Geometric and Functional Analysis]] |volume=16 |issue=6 |pages=1274–1290 |doi=10.1007/s00039-006-0588-1 |s2cid=43190254 }}
